question: Find out how many actors have a 'Shahrukh number' of 2? This means they acted in a film with someone who acted with Shahrukh Khan, but not directly with him.
sql:
WITH shahrukh_movies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc.MID 
    FROM M_Cast mc 
    JOIN Person p ON mc.PID = p.PID 
    WHERE p.Name = ' Shah Rukh Khan'
),
direct_co_stars AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc2.PID 
    FROM M_Cast mc2 
    JOIN shahrukh_movies sm ON mc2.MID = sm.MID
    WHERE mc2.PID != (SELECT PID FROM Person WHERE Name = ' Shah Rukh Khan')
),
co_star_movies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc3.MID 
    FROM M_Cast mc3 
    WHERE mc3.PID IN (SELECT PID FROM direct_co_stars)
),
second_degree_connections AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc4.PID 
    FROM M_Cast mc4 
    JOIN co_star_movies cm ON mc4.MID = cm.MID
    WHERE mc4.PID NOT IN (
        SELECT PID FROM shahrukh_movies
    ) AND mc4.PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM direct_co_stars)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mc4.PID) as shahrukh_number_2 
FROM M_Cast mc4 
WHERE mc4.PID IN (SELECT PID FROM second_degree_connections)
